def _cart_position(event, item, membership=None):
    return CartPosition.objects.create(
        item=item, price=23, expires=now() + timedelta(days=1), event=event, cart_id="123",
        used_membership=membership,
    )


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_ignores_products_without_requirement(event, customer, granting_ticket):
    cp = _cart_position(event, granting_ticket)
    validate_memberships_in_order(None, [cp], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_accepts_valid_membership(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, lock=True, testmode=False)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_rejects_missing_membership(event, customer, requiring_ticket):
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'membership' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_rejects_missing_customer(event, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(None, [cp], event)
    assert 'membership' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_rejects_membership_of_other_customer(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    other = event.organizer.customers.create(email="jane@example.org")
    other_membership = other.memberships.create(
        membership_type=membership.membership_type,
        date_start=membership.date_start,
        date_end=membership.date_end,
    )
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, other_membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'membership' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_rejects_type_not_allowed(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    other_type = event.organizer.membership_types.create(name="Other")
    membership.membership_type = other_type
    membership.save()
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'membership' in excinfo.value.message

@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_valid_from_not_chosen_only_checks_expiry(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):

    with freeze_time("2021-04-05T11:00:00+02:00"):

@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_rejects_expired_membership_with_valid_from_not_chosen(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):

@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_rejects_max_usages_within_batch(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):

    membership.membership_type.save()
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    cp2 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1, cp2], event)
